name: Degrees, Awards & Proficiencies

objectives.text: List the five degrees of FFA membership in order from Discovery to American
Match each FFA degree to the level of the organization that awards it, whether chapter, state, or national
Describe the requirements for earning the Discovery and Greenhand FFA Degrees
Distinguish among FFA degrees, proficiency awards, and Star awards as different forms of member recognition
Explain the purpose of proficiency awards in recognizing SAE achievement
Explain how the Honorary FFA Degree recognizes supporters of agricultural education and FFA
Classify an SAE into the appropriate proficiency award area and entrepreneurship or placement category
Explain how the Star Farmer, Star in Agribusiness, Star in Agricultural Placement, and Star in Agriscience awards advance from chapter to state to national recognition
Apply for the Chapter FFA Degree by documenting required activities, SAE earnings, and hours
Complete a proficiency award application that includes a financial summary, skills record, and SAE narrative
Analyze a proficiency award scoring rubric to identify strengths and gaps in an SAE record
Plan a pathway toward earning the State FFA Degree that meets required scholastic, leadership, and SAE benchmarks
Calculate whether SAE earnings, productive investment, and hours meet the thresholds for the American FFA Degree
Prepare for a proficiency or Star award interview by explaining SAE decisions, records, and skills gained
Evaluate a peer's American FFA Degree application against national requirements
Evaluate how the FFA degree and award programs motivate member growth in leadership, personal development, and career success

changes: Kept and lightly reworded all six original objectives, moving the Chapter Degree application to grade 9 where members typically earn it. Added objectives on matching degrees to awarding levels, Discovery Degree requirements, distinguishing types of recognition, the Honorary Degree, classifying SAEs into proficiency areas, the Star award progression, completing and analyzing proficiency applications, calculating American Degree thresholds, award interview preparation, and evaluating the motivational impact of recognition programs. Standards attached only where objectives identify FFA programs or evaluate FFA's impact on student learning.
